title: OpenWOP v2 error registry
description: Shape of spec/v2/errors.json: one row per registered error code. schemas/v2/error-envelope.schema.json and the status table in spec/v2/core/errors.md are generated from it by scripts/generate-error-envelope.mjs, which also validates the registry against this schema. Data, not a wire artifact.

vendorCodePattern.description: The pattern a vendor (non-registered) code MUST match.

code.description: The value of the envelope's `error` field. Unique across rows.

meaning.description: One plain-English line: what the code tells a client.

httpStatus.description: The status a host MUST answer with.

statusSource.description: Provenance of the status: stated in v1 prose, a v1 convention, or decided for v2.

retriable.description: Whether a client may retry the same request. Timing lives in Retry-After only.

details.description: The JSON Schema for this code's `details` object, or null when details is an open object.

since.description: The protocol version that first registered the code.

deprecated.description: True when the code is deprecated. Absent means not deprecated.

source.description: Provenance: the document or decision the row came from.
